page_title: LAZ 2-2 PAR | Lazio v Parma 28/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+3' A fine solo run by Dennis Man (Parma) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
90+2' Zion Suzuki (Parma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game is interrupted now, Zion Suzuki (Parma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
89' The corner from Pedro (Lazio) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki.
88' Substitution. Emanuele Valeri walks off the pitch and Mathias Lovik (Parma) comes on as a substitute.

87' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
87' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

87' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Zion Suzuki easily deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
84' 2 - 2 Luca Pellegrini showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Pedro (Lazio) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 2:2.
83' The ball is cleared after Dennis Man (Parma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
80' The referee shows the yellow card to Milan Djuric (Parma).
79' 1 - 2 Goal! Pedro (Lazio) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 1:2.

79' It's unbelievable, Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Zion Suzuki reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
78' Milan Djuric (Parma) is caught offside!
75' A yellow card for a tackle by Hernani (Parma). Juan Luca Sacchi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Parma comes to nothing.

72' Great save! Dennis Man (Parma) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Christos Mandas. Parma win a corner.
71' Today's match ends for Gustav Isaksen who will be replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
71' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matias Vecino (Lazio) replacing Nicolo Rovella.
71' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) replaces Mattia Zaccagni.
71' That's the end of the game for Antoine Hainaut, who is replaced by Botond Balogh (Parma).
71' Jacob Ondrejka comes off the pitch to be replaced by Dennis Man (Parma).
70' Pedro (Lazio) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.

69' It's unbelievable, Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the left post from a few yards out, but Zion Suzuki reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
68' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
67' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Zion Suzuki, who pulls off a stunning save!
62' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' Here comes a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny is given a rest as he is replaced by Hernani (Parma).
60' Christian Chivu prepares a substitution. Mateo Pellegrino is replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
57' Substitution. Boulaye Dia makes his way off the pitch and Pedro (Lazio) comes on as his replacement.
54' Giovanni Leoni (Parma) picks up a yellow card.
54' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) gets inside the box and tries to beat Christos Mandas with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
50' Juan Luca Sacchi shows the yellow card to Taty Castellanos (Lazio) for a heavy challenge.
48' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' 0 - 2 A goal! Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) broke through the defence and struck a shot inside the right post.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The linesman signals that Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
43' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
37' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
31' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner.
29' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Zion Suzuki easily deals with the threat.
26' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
26' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), but Christos Mandas is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
24' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a chip pass into the box, but Zion Suzuki is quickest to intercept the ball.
21' The game is interrupted as Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is flagged offside.
20' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
19' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Adam Marusic (Lazio) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender.
13' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
12' Simon Sohm (Parma) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but Christos Mandas makes a decent save to stop the effort.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
12' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Parma win a free kick.
9' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
7' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
5' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
3' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Emanuele Valeri tees up Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Christos Mandas.
2' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) is adjudged offside.
1' The match has just started.
Parma will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Juan Luca Sacchi is the one to supervise the game today.
